items.title: Pay invoice for inspection and brakes
items.quote: Bitte holen Sie es ab und bezahlen Sie die Rechnung bis 07.12.2026.
items.computation: The letter states two different payment dates: 'bezahlen Sie die Rechnung bis 07.12.2026' (07.12.2026) and separately 'Zahlungsziel 10.12.2026'. These are both fixed calendar dates printed in the letter, not periods to be counted, so no BGB counting or holiday-shift rule applies. 07.12.2026 is a Monday and 10.12.2026 is a Thursday, both ordinary business days, so no weekend adjustment would change either date. Because the two stated dates conflict, the earlier and more specific instruction ('bezahlen Sie die Rechnung bis 07.12.2026') is used as the binding due date, per the rule to take the earliest plausible date when a letter contradicts itself.

warnings: The letter gives two conflicting payment deadlines for the same invoice: 'bis 07.12.2026' in the body text and a separate 'Zahlungsziel 10.12.2026' near the bank details; the earlier date (07.12.2026) was used out of caution, but the person should confirm which date the workshop actually intends.

The IBAN printed (DE35 3705 0198 0005 5884 40) is a validly formatted German IBAN, but this does not confirm it belongs to Autowerkstatt Beispielkolben; compare it with any earlier invoice or the workshop's official contact details before paying.
